Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Regulatory Compliance: Ensure that all pharmacy operations comply with relevant laws, regulations, and standards set by the Health Department and BPOM (Badan POM).
- Supervision of Operations: Oversee the procurement, storage, and distribution of pharmaceutical products, ensuring quality control at every stage.
- Record Keeping: Maintain accurate records related to the entry, storage, and distribution of pharmaceutical products, ensuring traceability and compliance with regulatory requirements.
- Product Supervision: Monitor the safe handling and distribution of regulated products, ensuring they are stored and managed properly according to safety guidelines.
- Reporting: Prepare reports for relevant authorities, including the Health Department and BPOM, as required by law, regarding controlled substances and other pharmaceutical products.
- Team Supervision: Supervise and provide guidance to pharmacy staff, ensuring that tasks are performed according to established procedures and regulations.
- Quality Control: Ensure that pharmaceutical products meet the required safety and quality standards, identifying and addressing any issues related to product safety.
- Inventory Management: Manage and control stock levels, ensuring that products are available and handled according to their respective storage requirements.
- Customer Support: Ensure proper counseling and advice are provided to customers and patients regarding the use of medications.
- Training and Development: Train and educate pharmacy staff about changes in regulations and the proper handling of pharmaceutical products.

- Kepatuhan Regulasi: Memastikan bahwa semua operasi apotek mematuhi undang-undang, peraturan, dan standar yang berlaku dari Dinas Kesehatan dan BPOM.
- Pengawasan Operasional: Mengawasi pengadaan, penyimpanan, dan distribusi produk farmasi, memastikan kontrol kualitas di setiap tahap.
- Pencatatan: Memelihara catatan yang akurat terkait masuk, penyimpanan, dan distribusi produk farmasi, memastikan keterlacakan dan kepatuhan terhadap persyaratan regulasi.
- Pengawasan Produk: Memantau penanganan dan distribusi produk yang diatur, memastikan bahwa produk tersebut disimpan dan dikelola dengan benar sesuai pedoman keselamatan.
- Pelaporan: Menyusun laporan untuk otoritas terkait, termasuk Dinas Kesehatan dan BPOM, sebagaimana diwajibkan oleh hukum, terkait dengan obat-obatan terkendali dan produk farmasi lainnya.
- Pengawasan Tim: Mengawasi dan memberikan arahan kepada staf apotek, memastikan bahwa tugas dilakukan sesuai dengan prosedur dan peraturan yang berlaku.
- Kontrol Kualitas: Memastikan bahwa produk farmasi memenuhi standar keselamatan dan kualitas yang diperlukan, serta mengidentifikasi dan menangani masalah terkait keselamatan produk.
- Manajemen Inventaris: Mengelola dan mengontrol tingkat stok, memastikan ketersediaan produk serta penanganan yang sesuai dengan persyaratan penyimpanan masing-masing.
- Pelatihan dan Pengembangan: Melatih dan mendidik staf apotek tentang perubahan regulasi dan penanganan produk farmasi yang benar.
